title.narrative: Young women's and men's entrepreneurial skills for self employment and SME activities enhanced/ increased

description.narrative:
Kenya is addressing the urgent need to enhance the entrepreneurial skills of its young population, encompassing both women and men, to foster self-employment and strengthen small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). In response to the country's recent political stabilization and economic growth potential, this CPO aims to improve capacities for self-employment and facilitate the growth of sustainable enterprises, thereby contributing to achieving full and productive employment for all, as stipulated in the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), particularly Goal 8.
The primary focus of this initiative is the development of an inclusive and supportive entrepreneurial ecosystem. It seeks to deliver capacity-building programs tailored for aspiring entrepreneurs, with specific training in green business practices, digital marketing, and value chains in key industries such as agribusiness and leather production. Special attention will be directed towards empowering women entrepreneurs through targeted training and support initiatives.
Key partnerships include collaboration with local employers' federations and trade unions, which will enhance their institutional capacities to support their members effectively. The initiative also emphasizes creating dialogue platforms that engage multinational enterprises to promote decent work within their supply chains, ensuring that local communities benefit from a growing renewable energy sector, driven by public-private partnerships.
Through this strategic approach, the CPO aspires to cultivate conditions for job creation, enhance productivity, and achieve a sustainable economic transformation in Kenya, ultimately laying the groundwork for equitable opportunities across all segments of society.
